support_spans: a 34×28 mm sacrococcygeal mass with internal and external components
a 60×70×57 mm sacrococcygeal mass with mixed features—predominantly solid with a 40 mm cyst—and no invasion or compression of pelvic structures or the coccyx (Altman type II)
candidates.why: The presence of a sacrococcygeal mass with mixed solid and cystic components is consistent with sacrococcygeal teratoma.

candidates.name: Neonatal hemorrhagic shock

pallor, prolonged capillary refill

candidates.why: The presence of active bleeding, pallor, and prolonged capillary refill, along with severe metabolic acidosis, is consistent with neonatal hemorrhagic shock.
